content.what_it_is: MATLAB comparison-movie script for the FUNWAVE-TVD vessel_propeller_effect case: builds an MP4 contrasting sediment concentration with and without the propeller sediment source. It reads two run directories — fdir='output/' (with propeller) and fdir1='output_nopropeller/' (L2-L3) — sizes the grid from dep_00000 (L5, L8), builds x,y with dx=dy=2.0 (L10-L13), selects frames nfile=1..75 (L17), opens MPEG-4 videoOut.mp4 at 10 fps quality 100 (L20-L25), and sets an 8x6-inch jet figure (L27-L31). Per frame (L33-L87): loads eta, C (concentration), DchgS, DchgB from the propeller run (L35-L39) and the same four fields from the no-propeller run (L41-L44), then draws three panels — (311) eta with caxis [-0.3 1.5] titled ' Time = <nfile*1.0> sec ' implying 1 s output interval (L46-L53); (312) ch1*100 no-propeller concentration with caxis [0.0 0.01] titled 'Sediment concentration without propeller' (L59-L65); (313) ch*100 with-propeller concentration, same caxis, titled 'Sediment concentration with propeller' (L71-L77). Each frame is rasterized at 300 dpi into mov(num).cdata and written to the video (L82-L85); video closed at L88.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)
ch — sediment concentration C, propeller run (L37)
ds — suspended-load depth change DchgS, propeller run (L38)
db — bed-load depth change DchgB, propeller run (L39)
mov — struct array of frame cdata (L83)

equations.ref: time label assuming 1 s output interval

io.name: 3-panel per-frame figure: eta, concentration without and with propeller

unresolved: The concentration fields are multiplied by 100 but displayed against caxis [0.0 0.01] (L60, L62, L72, L74) with a colorbar labeled plain ' c ' — the effective displayed range is raw C in [0, 1e-4]; the units and the reason for the x100 scaling are not stated.
ds/db and ds1/db1 (DchgS/DchgB depth-change fields, L38-L39, L43-L44) are loaded every frame but never plotted.
eta1 (no-propeller eta, L41) is loaded but never plotted.
The 1 s output interval implied by the title (L50) must match the case input; unverifiable here.
dep is loaded from dep_00000 (L5) — a time-stamped depth output name implying morphology updates — but depth evolution is not shown.

mov(num).cdata stores unresized 300-dpi frames for all 75 frames (L82-L85), unlike siblings that resize to 576x1024; memory-heavy and the commented vidHeight/vidWidth (L23-L24) confirm resizing was dropped.
